title: Oxidation & Reduction Study Game — LEO Goes GER!
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Interactive REDOX study game with six modes: Oxidation States, Identify REDOX, Activity Series, Half-Reaction Method, Acidic REDOX, and Basic REDOX. Practice individual oxidation numbers and complete charts; identify oxidation, reduction, oxidizing agents, and reducing agents; predict activity-series reactions; and balance equations through guided steps. Includes hints, answer reveals, completed-work review with optional automatic expansion, visual cancellation of electrons and common species, an activity series chart, embedded Dr. Dan video lessons, scoring, streaks, celebration animations, and a responsive pastel interface with Pocket Leo.
